title: Kissed Light Jamaican Chicken Braise
description: A fresh and snappy Jamaican dish featuring amazake in a light braise, cooked to perfection in an agave leaf vessel, this recipe is nut-free-friendly and perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together amazake, garlic, ginger, thyme, allspice, agave nectar, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Place the chicken mixture in the center of a large agave leaf, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Fold the agave leaf over the chicken to form a packet, and secure with kitchen twine.
Place the packet in a large Dutch oven or oven-safe pot with a tight-fitting lid.
Add the chicken broth to the pot, covering the packet completely.
Cover the pot and transfer to the preheated oven.
Braise the chicken for 45 minutes, or until cooked through.
Remove the pot from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the chicken hot, garnished with diced scotch bonnet peppers.
